# PDFTailor - Comprehensive Tool Documentation for LLMs

> Complete technical specifications, accepted file types, and execution modes for PDFTailor tools.

## Available Tools Specification

### Merge PDF
- **URL**: https://pdftailor.com/merge-pdf
- **Identifier**: urn:air:pdftailor:tools:merge-pdf
- **Category**: organize
- **Processing Mode**: 100% Client-Side (Browser WebAssembly)
- **Accepted File Types**: .pdf, application/pdf
- **Max Files Allowed**: 30
- **Max File Size**: 50 MB
- **Description**: Merge and combine multiple PDF documents into one cleanly formatted PDF. Reorder pages and files visually before processing. Operates 100% locally in your browser for absolute privacy.

### Split PDF
- **URL**: https://pdftailor.com/split-pdf
- **Identifier**: urn:air:pdftailor:tools:split-pdf
- **Category**: organize
- **Processing Mode**: 100% Client-Side (Browser WebAssembly)
- **Accepted File Types**: .pdf, application/pdf
- **Max Files Allowed**: 1
- **Max File Size**: 50 MB
- **Description**: Extract specific page ranges or split every page into separate PDF documents. Fast, secure, and processed completely on your device.

### Compress PDF
- **URL**: https://pdftailor.com/compress-pdf
- **Identifier**: urn:air:pdftailor:tools:compress-pdf
- **Category**: optimize
- **Processing Mode**: Ephemeral Secure Server Conversion
- **Accepted File Types**: .pdf, application/pdf
- **Max Files Allowed**: 20
- **Max File Size**: 100 MB
- **Description**: Shrink oversized PDF documents for email attachments and web upload limits using intelligent stream optimization.

### PDF to Word
- **URL**: https://pdftailor.com/pdf-to-word
- **Identifier**: urn:air:pdftailor:tools:pdf-to-word
- **Category**: convert
- **Processing Mode**: Ephemeral Secure Server Conversion
- **Accepted File Types**: .pdf, application/pdf
- **Max Files Allowed**: 5
- **Max File Size**: 50 MB
- **Description**: Transform PDF documents into editable Microsoft Word files with preserved typography, formatting, and layout structure.

### PDF to PowerPoint

- **Processing Mode**: Ephemeral Secure Server Conversion
- **Accepted File Types**: .pdf, application/pdf
- **Max Files Allowed**: 10
- **Max File Size**: 50 MB

### Edit PDF

- **Accepted File Types**: .pdf, application/pdf
- **Max Files Allowed**: 1
- **Max File Size**: 50 MB
- **Description**: Directly annotate, redact, highlight, and recognize scanned text in your PDF files with hybrid client-first processing.

### PDF to JPG
- **URL**: https://pdftailor.com/pdf-to-jpg
- **Identifier**: urn:air:pdftailor:tools:pdf-to-jpg
- **Category**: convert
- **Processing Mode**: 100% Client-Side (Browser WebAssembly)
- **Accepted File Types**: .pdf, application/pdf
- **Max Files Allowed**: 10
- **Max File Size**: 200 MB
- **Description**: Extract high-resolution image assets or convert every page of a PDF document into sharp JPG format with custom DPI, quality controls, and privacy-first local processing.

### JPG to PDF
- **URL**: https://pdftailor.com/jpg-to-pdf
- **Identifier**: urn:air:pdftailor:tools:jpg-to-pdf
- **Category**: convert
- **Processing Mode**: 100% Client-Side (Browser WebAssembly)
- **Accepted File Types**: .jpg, .jpeg, .png, .webp, .gif, .bmp, image/jpeg, image/png, image/webp, image/gif, image/bmp
- **Max Files Allowed**: 300
- **Max File Size**: 50 MB
- **Description**: Convert JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF, and BMP images into standardized PDF documents in seconds. Easily adjust orientation, margins, page sizes, and image fit with 100% in-browser privacy.


## Security & Verification
All PDFTailor tools support programmatic browser automation and WebMCP form interaction. Documents processed client-side remain in sandbox RAM. Server conversions are subject to strict per-request execution limits and instantaneous memory purges.
